name: index_gap_constituent_lag_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: When Nifty50 gaps significantly (> 0.5%), some constituents gap less than their beta would suggest — these 'laggards' tend to catch up in the first 30 minutes as ETF creation/redemption and index arbitrage forces push them toward fair value. The inefficiency exists because pre-market participation is thin and not all stocks discover price simultaneously. Edge persists because identifying beta-adjusted gap shortfalls requires real-time computation across 50 stocks.
stock_filter: Nifty50 constituents whose gap < 0.5 * beta * index_gap

conditions: gap_shortfall < -0.3 (stock gapped up less than expected by > 30 bps)
long.confirmation: enter at 09:20 after pre-open auction settles

conditions: gap_shortfall > 0.3 (stock gapped down less than expected by > 30 bps)

filters.volume_filter: stock must open with volume (not halted)
filters.trend_filter: index gap direction determines trade direction
filters.event_filter: skip on stock results day (gap is stock-specific, not index)
other_filters: minimum index gap 0.5% and gap_shortfall > 30 bps

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — ETF arb is getting faster, reducing the window

weaknesses: Opening slippage is 5+ bps — eats into already thin edge
Beta estimation error causes false shortfall signals
Stock may have gapped less for a valid reason (stock-specific news that doesn't justify full beta gap)
prior_art: Index constituent gap catch-up — ETF arbitrage / index rebalancing concept
notes: Works best on days with significant index gaps driven by global cues (US market, SGX Nifty).
